stats.label: Endurance
stats.description: Your life: 20 + a random number 0–9 at the start. At 0 you die.

stats.label: Combat Skill
stats.description: Your fighting skill: 10 + a random number 0–9 at the start.

locations.label: Weapons
locations.description: At most two weapons. Fighting without one: Combat Skill −4 (the Unarmed trait).

items.name: Meal
items.description: Eat one when the book says so, or lose 3 Endurance.

items.name: Healing Potion
items.description: Laumspur and the like: Endurance +4 when used after a fight.

locations.label: Special Items
locations.description: Carried apart from the Backpack: maps, keys, the book's special things.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: Blend into the surroundings and pass for a local.

traits.name: Hunting
traits.description: Never go hungry in the wild: no Meal needed there.

traits.name: Sixth Sense
traits.description: Warns of danger and hidden purposes.

traits.name: Tracking
traits.description: Read tracks and find the right path.

traits.name: Healing
traits.description: Endurance +1 for each section passed without a fight.

traits.name: Weaponskill
traits.description: Combat Skill +2 while fighting with the weapon you mastered.

traits.name: Mindshield
traits.description: No loss of Combat Skill to an enemy's psychic attack.

traits.name: Mindblast
traits.description: Combat Skill +2 in a fight, unless the enemy is immune.

traits.name: Animal Kinship
traits.description: Speak with some animals and sense their intent.

traits.name: Mind Over Matter
traits.description: Move small things with the mind.

traits.name: Unarmed
traits.description: No weapon in hand: Combat Skill −4. Remove it when you take a weapon.
